node.title: v13 finite adjacent compiler (endpoint convention)
node.statement: COMPILER THEOREM (upstream: przchojecki/rs-mca towards-prize.md (2026-07-01 revision) + cap25 v13 raw notes): if the exact unsafe inequality holds at agreement a0, and the safe upper ledger at a1 = a0+1 is a disjoint/first-match integer sum bounded by B*, then a1 is the first safe agreement and the closed-radius threshold is pinned at the a0/a1 boundary. PROVED (one paragraph): unsafe(a0) gives count > B* at a0; the ledger gives count <= B* at a1; counts are monotone in agreement; hence the crossing is exactly between a0 and a1 -- the adjacent determination in the sense of the prize spec and of our mca_grand statement. Matches the F_17^32 pinned row (LD 7 at 506, 6 at 507).
